name: Measures
responsibility: Lists every module of a reading with its interface counts, commit count and unjoined pairs, sorted by the count a reader chooses
description: One history read of a revision answers for every part at once, and a selection shares it. A row selects its module on the picture. An unread part states why, and no count joins a score. A fourth view, What this branch changed, holds the branch footprint.
